completeness_review_rows.subject: [Shared], I-19/20
completeness_review_rows.gap_text: No universal cap, cancellation latency, retry or rollback policy selected; proposed individual-fill restoration does not generalize to other operations or resources.

completeness_review_rows.subject: [Open/save], I-01/07
completeness_review_rows.gap_text: Owner adoption of Q-58 to Q-64; diagnostic design/post-disposal lifecycle, source access/stability, repeated saves, revisions, encryption/output and disposal details. Conditional proof and retry remain deferred.

completeness_review_rows.subject: [Inspection], I-02/03/15
completeness_review_rows.gap_text: Indexing/coordinates, INSPECT-FORM-05's malformed-version/language-escape/error edges, exact public identity type/malformed/incomplete reporting, CMS depth, source lifetime/limits/cancellation.

completeness_review_rows.subject: [Forms], I-04/05/06
completeness_review_rows.gap_text: Format review of recognizer/rich blank, A4 impact evidence for list/flag eligibility, storage/export/security mappings and font/resource measurements remain. A4 selects refusal at/above 33,554,432 bytes using independent research; boundary/internal-limit disposition and target measurements remain open.

completeness_review_rows.subject: [Metadata], I-08
completeness_review_rows.gap_text: Exact XML/RDF/encoding shapes, custom reserved keys, public representations and measured limit values remain open. Proposed borrowed-stream and cancellation boundaries await review.

completeness_review_rows.subject: [Attachments], I-09
completeness_review_rows.gap_text: Direct-operation names/collisions/associated-file identity, decoded-limit defaults/enforcement, input/output lifetime, safe paths, atomicity/cancellation.

completeness_review_rows.subject: [Pages], I-10/11
completeness_review_rows.gap_text: Rotation interpretation, empty/default selections, feature subsets/inspection scope, encrypted/signed outputs, referenced-file/unaffected relationship classification, measured numeric limits, streamed partial failures and diagnostics.

completeness_review_rows.subject: [Security], I-12/18
completeness_review_rows.gap_text: Schemes/roles, exact operation checks, malformed grants/locks, permission-setting output, credential/cancellation/failure handling.

completeness_review_rows.subject: [Signing], I-13/14
completeness_review_rows.gap_text: Provider/algorithm/field/seed/token subset, revision/staging, reservations/limits, side effects/cancellation/retry/output failure.

completeness_review_rows.subject: [Images], I-17
completeness_review_rows.gap_text: Format/transparency/profile subset, shared geometry, fit/clipping, decode/buffer limits, lifetime and failure/cancellation.

completeness_review_rows.subject: [Workflows], I-16
completeness_review_rows.gap_text: Owner adoption/runtime verification of proposals, engine form rules, exact API/repetition, special terminals, source stability/positions, identity, unmeasured resource defaults/checkpoint thresholds/latency, caller-resource effects and owned cleanup, workflow cleanup-only/finalization/diagnostics.
